mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_hygiene_check (room_id, score, deduct_reason, check_date, checker_name, create_time) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{score}, #{deductReason}, #{checkDate}, #{checkerName}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT h.*, CONCAT(b.name, ' - ', r.room_number) as roomName FROM tb_hygiene_check h JOIN tb_room r ON h.room_id = r.room_id JOIN tb_building b ON r.building_id = b.building_id WHERE r.room_id IN ( -- 子查询：找出该辅导员管理的学生所在的房间ID (去重) SELECT DISTINCT s.room_id FROM tb_student s WHERE s.counselor_id = #{counselorId} ) ORDER BY h.check_date DESC
